episode.title: What’s Wrong With the Indian Media?

chapters.title: Intro: The World is a Housing Complex

episode.tagline: The Indian media has lost its way. But how? And why? Well, there have been crises of relevance, purpose, money, quality, trust, power, incentives and attention.
episode.about: In this episode, Amit gives us a lowdown on exactly what’s wrong with the Indian media.
